nom: COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Repairing Serum for Sooothing & Hydrating 3.38 oz.

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found the serum reduced oiliness and left no greasy residue, calling it a good base before makeup.
segments.dry: The most frequently mentioned skin type; most reviewers describe visible relief for dry, flaky, or dehydrated skin, though a few report worsened peeling and dehydration instead.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (oily T-zone with dry patches) generally report better balance and hydration without extra shine or breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with eczema or rosacea, report no stinging or irritation, but a distinct minority describe allergic reactions, rashes, or new breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s generally report smoother, more hydrated skin and fewer visible fine lines, though one mature reviewer with sun spots and wrinkles saw no difference.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers in their 50s report smoother texture and fewer visible fine lines with regular use, but one reviewer with sun spots and wrinkles saw no change after waiting to judge results.
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported as effective for dehydration and tightness, including one case describing a restored skin barrier within days; one reviewer instead found her skin more dehydrated after a month of use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness report a calming effect, but a handful describe developing rashes, hives, or burning after use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the serum with repairing a damaged or over-exfoliated barrier, including recovery from retinoid-related irritation and comedones clearing over time.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, discoloration, and post-acne marks, with one comparing the improvement favorably to professional IPL laser treatments.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some with hormonal or acne-prone skin, report fewer breakouts and clearer skin; others describe new bumps, cystic pimples, or breakouts appearing after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: The few reviewers who mention oily skin describe reduced oiliness and no greasy residue, though this is a minor theme compared to hydration.

aspects.libelle: Slimy, gooey texture that absorbs quickly
Great value, small amount needed per use
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup
Allergic reactions or breakouts in a minority of users
Counterfeit risk from third-party Amazon sellers

extraits.texte: Ugh, this has been a nightmare for my skin! My skin is typically sensitive and dry... but reading all the positive reviews led me to think this might be the game-changer I needed for my skin's barrier. Normally my skin will react right away to a product that's not compatible (it will immediately sting, get hot and red, and I know to wash whatever product off right away). This product was different. The first day I tried it, it went on and soaked in and didn't cause a reaction. I thought "this is great!" So the next day I applied the product more liberally over my face. On day 3 I noticed a bunch of tiny bumps all over my face and the bridge of my nose. I figured perhaps this was my skin purging, or slight acne as it adjusted. I discontinued using the serum on day 3 when I noticed these bumps. But by day 4 my face was red, it stung, and it itched like crazy (PHOTO). It has now been a full 7 days of discontinued use of COSRX and my poor face is still healing from the rash that I had. For anyone else suffering from a reaction, this is what I did to heal: discontinue using the serum and all other products (especially ones with active ingredients). Wash with Vanicream gentle cleanser. I used Avene Cicalfate+ Restorative Protective Cream or Dr Jart+ Cicapair Intense Soothing Repair Cream (nothing else....which was so hard because my skin was red and it eventually peeled). I even took Benadryl one evening just so my skin would stop itching. After about a week my skin is almost back

I have a mature skin, with some sun spots and fine lines wrinkles. I haven’t seen any difference before and after. I waited some time before writing a review since some products take time to be effective and I wanted to be fair. I bought this while looking for a rosacea product. I saw that product could help reduce “crisis”. I really don’t know if it was effective or not for this purpose since it coincided with a non stress period in my life, but my rosacea reduced a lot. The product packaging is beautiful. It is transparent and the product inside has the consistency of a liquid soap (sort of) and it is transparent. When applied, the feeling is like when we use soap on face and leave it for a while. It looks like there is a little “pull” (not the same, but similar ). I can’t tell about effectiveness since I saw no difference on my skin (maybe this is not made for a mature skin. I don’t know). It is not oily at all. It dries fast and doesn’t stay “glued”.

extraits.titre: I really really wanted to love it
extraits.texte: I started using Tretinoin (rx grade retinol) and have already dry (but not sensitive) skin, and it made me peel like it’s supposed to. I thought this would be my saving grace, as it seemed to be in EVERYONES skin care regimen on social media and thousands of people swore by it. Helps with hydration, great under thick moisturizers to help lock in it’s ingredients.. But it wasn’t for me. After a month or so of use my skin was peeling worse than before and was even more dehydrated. Not sure why, but I’d read other reviews stating the same. I hope this works for you, since it’s a holy grail product for majority of people!

extraits.titre: I Finally Understand the Snail Mucin Hype
extraits.texte: I’ll be honest — I held out on the snail mucin trend for a long time. I didn’t quite understand the appeal, and with so many products already in my routine, I wasn’t convinced I needed another hydrating serum. After finally trying this one, I understand completely. This isn’t just another trend — it’s genuinely a must-have. At 52, with post-menopausal dry skin, I’m always looking for products that improve hydration, support the barrier, and help my skin look healthier overall. This serum does exactly that — and it does it in a way that feels gentle, consistent, and easy to use. The texture is what makes this stand out. It has that signature snail mucin slip — slightly viscous, but not sticky or heavy. Once applied, it spreads easily and absorbs surprisingly well. It leaves the skin feeling hydrated, smoother, and more comfortable almost immediately. What I noticed most is how it improves overall skin quality. My skin looks more hydrated, more balanced, and just healthier. It doesn’t create a heavy or greasy finish — instead, it gives that subtle, hydrated glow that works beautifully under moisturizer and sunscreen. This is also an excellent barrier-supporting serum, especially when using stronger actives. I’ve found that when I incorporate this into my routine, my skin feels calmer, more resilient, and less reactive. It’s one of those products that quietly makes everything else work better. extraits.titre: WORKS FOR MY HIGHLY SENSITIVE SKIN!
extraits.texte: I have always had sensitive skin. I have battled eczema and rashes that no doctor could diagnose. About 6 years ago I constantly had the rash in the last photo on and off. It burned and itched and felt like I had hundreds of blisters on my face. My dermatologist prescribed me steroids and steroid creams (not great because it thins your skin out over time). I’ve done extensive allergy tests with no answer to what causes this. I just turned 32 and desperately want to be a skincare girly. But the only things I could use on my face were okay sensitive face wash and Aveeno baby lavender lotion! Anything else has caused me to have a reaction. Even makeup wipes would send my skin into a frenzy and I’d end up at the doctors office. I’ve been doing research and wanted to use things that fellow sensitive skin people have tried with success. Along with reading extensive reviews. I decided to try this product and I am happy to say that I will be purchasing again! There is no stinging, burning or itching of any kind! I mean JUST LOOK AT MY GLOWING SKIN!

I’ve been seeing this everywhere and had to see if it lived up to the hype. I’ve been using this morning and night for about 2 weeks and I can say I understand the hype! My skin looks better than it has in so long. Firstly, the texture surprised me. When you think snail mucine, you think slimy and gross. This wasn’t sticky or slimy whatsoever. I was afraid it was gonna leave my skin feeling gross and slippery. Surprisingly, my skin drank it right up! No residue whatsoever and it’s a nice primer before makeup. I have oily skin and it’s helped with that as well. My skin is so soft, with a nice healthy glow. I’ve noticed my red spots from past acne is fading and my skin just overall looks great. Highly recommend!

I cannot believe my eyes! I received this 3 weeks ago and have used it 3-5 days per week. I have never had this much skin peeling even with RetinA. At first I thought it might be the snail essence gel itself peeling off but this picture is after it has been completely washed off. The improvement I have seen in my hyperpigmentation I could only achieve with visits to my dermatologist to get IPL laser treatments for $200 each. You can see in the photo the areas where hyperpigmentation is now gone and where I am shedding. I have never been this impressed with a skincare product!!!
